name: ChatGPT
capability: Draft, analyse files and create work you can review.
access: Start with a browser account; file and calculation tools depend on mode and plan.

name: Claude
capability: Draft documents and analyse uploaded files; create editable outputs.
access: Browser account; check file creation and usage limits in your plan.

name: Gemini
capability: Work with uploaded documents and spreadsheets.
access: Google account; Workspace permissions and upload limits vary.

name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
capability: Draft and revise work in the Microsoft 365 environment.
access: Check the specific app, work account licence and administrator settings.

name: Notion AI
capability: Write, search workspace knowledge and turn notes into tasks.
access: Best evaluated inside an existing Notion workspace; full AI access depends on plan.

name: NotebookLM
capability: Ask questions of selected sources and inspect supporting citations.
access: Google account; currently labelled Gemini Notebook on the presenting account.

name: Adobe Acrobat AI
capability: Ask about PDFs and follow citations back to source passages.
access: Check AI Assistant/PDF Spaces entitlement; OCR quality affects scanned documents.

name: Excel Copilot
capability: Explore spreadsheet data, formulas, summaries and visualisations in Excel.
access: Requires an eligible account and supported workbook setup; check Excel requirements.

name: Julius
capability: Analyse spreadsheet data and turn findings into reports.
access: Account and usage allowance required; verify calculations against your source file.

name: Codex
capability: Build small tools, edit files and run checks in an authorised workspace.
access: Prepare a demo folder and tool access first; review files and test results.

name: Claude Code
capability: Read a project, change files and run development commands.
access: Coding workspace setup and an eligible subscription/API account; technical review needed.

name: Cursor
capability: Build and revise code with an agent inside an editor.
access: Install an editor and prepare the project; review commands and changes.

name: Replit
capability: Build and preview apps from a brief in a browser workspace.
access: Check build credits and hosting costs separately; test before publishing.

name: Lovable
capability: Create and iterate on web apps from a natural-language brief.
access: Check credits, hosting and backend requirements; review access and data handling.

name: Make
capability: Connect apps and branch a repeatable workflow in a visual builder.
access: Connect authorised accounts; budget for automation credits and any AI provider usage.

name: Zapier
capability: Run actions in connected apps when a trigger occurs.
access: Account connections and a tested trigger/action setup; features and task limits vary.

name: n8n
capability: Build flexible workflows with AI steps and human fallbacks.
access: More technical setup; cloud subscription or maintained self-hosting plus provider costs.

name: Canva
capability: Turn a brief into designs, images and social content you can edit.
access: Check AI feature limits and asset licences for the account you use.

name: Gamma
capability: Turn a brief or source material into a presentation draft.
access: Check creation credits, export options and plan limits.

name: Descript
capability: Edit recorded video through its transcript and create captions or clips.
access: Prepare a recording you may use; check media minutes and AI credits.

name: Otter
capability: Transcribe meetings and extract summaries and action items.
access: Obtain participant agreement before recording; check language support and meeting limits.

name: DeepL
capability: Translate supported languages and documents with consistent glossary terms.
access: Confirm your exact language pair and glossary/file features before subscribing.

name: Intercom Fin
capability: Answer support questions from approved knowledge and route exceptions to people.
access: Needs maintained support content, escalation rules and a costed support setup.

name: Perplexity
capability: Research the web with linked sources.
access: Check source dates and original pages; deeper research allowances vary by plan.
